name: Dotted Answers
description: Two dotted-eighth answers, each a fifth higher.

name: Falling Octaves
description: Three eighth-note echoes falling an octave each time.

name: Major Seventh
description: A close major seventh on every key.

name: Minor Ninth
description: A parallel minor ninth: root, minor third, fifth, seventh and ninth.

name: Open Fifths
description: Root, fifth and octave, leaving room for a melody's thirds.

name: Quiet Sixteenths
description: Four soft sixteenth echoes behind short keys.

name: Rising Minor Strum
description: A minor seventh strummed gently from low to high.

name: Suspended Seconds
description: A stack of seconds and fifths, without a third.

name: Suspended Strum
description: An open suspended chord spread across a short strum.

name: Triplet Climb
description: Triplet echoes climbing in minor thirds.
